verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own observe() primitive discovers actionable elements on the current page and returns structured actions that a developer can validate before acting or execute. That directly matches previewing candidate actions before committing. This is preview-then-act, not dry-run simulation or sandbox isolation, and the story asks only for preview. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the returned action schema and of plan-style multi-step previews, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the observe-then-act workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
